description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE December 16, 2015 Contact: Mike Trujillo mike [at] barraganforcongress [dot] com Congresswoman Debbie Dingell Endorses Nanette Barragán in CA-44 Primary SAN PEDRO, CA – Today, Democratic Congresswoman Debbie Dingell (MI-12) endorsed Nanette Barrágan for Congress in the Democratic primary in California’s 44th District. Congresswoman Dingell is an active member of the DCCC
title: Congresswoman Debbie Dingell Endorses Nanette Barragán in CA-44 Primary - Nanette Barragan For Congress (CA-44)
